title: RNA/DNA Forensic Differentiation Standard
description: Defines the roles of hidden and visible artifacts in the metagit ecosystem.

values.name: RNA (Forensic Substrate)
values.rule: All process-oriented artifacts, logs, intermediate states, and high-verbosity journals MUST reside in '.hidden/' subdirectories within their respective type-attribute leaf folders (e.g., 'json/.hidden/', 'md/.hidden/').
values.rationale: RNA is permanent and essential for forensic reconstruction (machine-readable), but it is not intended for primary human attention. This eukaryotic structure keeps the forensic noise isolated within the relevant data type folder.

values.name: DNA (Human-Centric Heartwood)
values.rule: Only refined, high-signal artifacts approved for permanent inclusion reside in parent leaf folders (md/ or json/).
values.rationale: DNA/Heartwood is curated for human focus. It represents the 'legislative' history and strategic realizations of the swarm, isolated from the noise of the survival layer.

values.name: Hidden Report Mandate
values.rule: The majority of session reports are RNA and must be sequestered in '.hidden/'. Only reports that define the session's 'Chord' or critical realizations are promoted to Heartwood.
values.rationale: Protects the human user from attention fragmentation and cognitive overload by prioritizing high-signal outputs.
